```renyi
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let words be text.to_lower().split(" ")
  let filtered_words be for each word in words where not word.is_empty() collect word
  let counts be for each word in filtered_words group by word count
  let entries be for each word, occurrences in counts collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: occurrences)
  return entries.sorted by entry.occurrences descending
end
```

```renyi
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let words be text.to_lower().split(" ")
  let words be words.without("")
  let counts be
    for each word in words
    group by word
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: word.count)
  let counts be counts.sorted by entry.occurrences descending
  return counts
end
```

```renyi
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let words be text.to_lower().split(" ").without("").distinct()
  let counts be
    for each word in words
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: text.to_lower().split(" ").count(word))
  let sorted_counts be counts.sorted()
  return sorted_counts.reversed()
end
```
